description: Zhang Fei, stocky Chinese warrior, approved pixel art. Front view. Black beard and topknot, red headband with two tails, dark gold-trimmed armor, red cloth, boots, long dark spear with large silver serpent blade.
action: One seamless front-facing combat running cycle in place, two alternating steps over15 frames. Follow the skeleton foot contacts and brief flight phases. Grounded foot moves backward under body, then lifts and swings forward. RIGHT hand continuously holds the same spear grip; LEFT empty arm swings opposite legs without stretching. Carry the large rigid serpent spear upright beside body, no attack. Preserve headband knot attached to head, both tails and all character proportions. Fixed south/front camera and pivot. Last frame leads naturally into first running frame, no pause or idle pose at loop seam. Source image defines appearance, not a stationary first running pose. No camera movement, effects or afterimages.
